summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coordinates) pairs with int64 coords of shape (ndim, 2) in the original frame; set_rnd skips dunder attributes; docstring updated), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter generator; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; PatchDataset docstring uses float; __all__ includes PatchIter), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry after GridPatchDataset), and tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape, test_loading_array, and a collate test). Nothing was run or committed. Open items: the docstring example output was derived by hand, the value checks in test_loading_array use a constant-shift property rather than fixed reference values, and other iter_patch callers were not exhaustively checked. Run pytest tests/test_grid_dataset.py to verify.
